_about: The phones Firebase Test Lab runs the device check on (DEVICE_LAB.md). Each wish names a 2022 phone by Test Lab model id or by a piece of its catalogue name; the first one the catalogue has is used, at the newest Android it offers. Ordered by priority: the free plan runs five physical devices a day, and `max` takes the first that many found. Spread across GPU makers on purpose: a driver bug (PowerVR under Opera) is what a frame-rate test alone never shows. Name pieces match as substrings, so a wish names what only its phone has: "Galaxy A04" also matched the A04s, an Exynos with the A13's Mali-G52, and the PowerVR slot ran no PowerVR. The catalogue each run saw is kept in the run's device-lab-results artifact (catalogue.json).
